decision: The maintained source journey and extracted customer package are documentation-ready within the explicitly static and local evidence scope. Exact rendered-input tree equivalence, render-byte continuity, and current independent visual reinspection support carrying the visual finding across the repaired checkpoint without claiming a fresh browser capture. No material product-truth, unsafe-procedure, access-path, licensing-candor, source/package-parity, or rendered-layout defect remains.

exclusions: Fresh browser capture at the repaired checkpoint
Fresh-host installation, discovery, enabled state, invocation, and model behavior

source_equivalence.disposition: Sufficient for current static visual closure because every rendered input and retained pixel artifact is identical and the current reviewer reinspected the retained views; insufficient for fresh-browser or cross-browser claims.

checks.evidence: HEAD is 06b89ea3b27600452056edbdfad9ccaff3c7fcaf; current root documents, docs, and plugins/nova-the-optimal-ai have no drift from that checkpoint.

Current and origin docs Git trees are both a33fb1111297986410ec6e2fae2c97c21a0a603e; plugin trees are both 0acfbddbe6c2553ee3132262a1740fbad95a80c6. All 12 PNGs match their manifest dimensions and hashes and are byte-identical to the archived origin packet.

The reviewer inspected a disposable contact sheet generated from all 11 retained desktop PNGs and a separate view of the retained 390x844 mobile overview. Hierarchy, navigation, spacing, calls to action, and hero presentation remain coherent with no visible clipping or overlap. Inspection did not create a new browser capture.

The current receipt reports 25 visible roots, 16 Faculty Cores, 131 customer references, no findings, candidate_state=built_awaiting_independent_review, and redistribution_state=blocked_pending_component_grants.
Independent SHA-256 comparison checked 7 maintained root documents and 24 docs-tree files and found 0 missing files and 0 byte differences.
Independent rerun checked 16 maintained documents and 13 local references with no findings.
Independent rerun of docs/check_site.py passed 11 HTML pages.

The documentation provides entry, complete Codex install commands, one real-invocation prompt, Claude-compatible alternatives, optional-state authority, same-ID upgrade and rollback, troubleshooting, support, security, notices, and explicit evidence boundaries.

Pages use lang=en, one H1, labelled navigation, skip links, main landmarks, useful image alternatives, scoped table headers, visible focus, reduced-motion handling, responsive navigation, and non-sensory warning wording. This is static and visual evidence, not an assistive-technology session.

The journey separates package presence, installation, discovery, invocation, behavior, publication, and outcomes, and identifies the six unresolved redistribution components without treating notices as permission.

conditions.affected_user_task: Customers navigating installation, trust, support, security, upgrade, and troubleshooting with keyboard, screen reader, zoom, or other assistive technology.
conditions.evidence_gap: No complete keyboard walkthrough, screen-reader session, assistive-technology matrix, or representative-user study was retained.
conditions.consequence: This review cannot support a formal accessibility-conformance claim or a claim that representative users completed the journey.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Before making either claim, run keyboard-only and representative screen-reader walkthroughs over the main customer tasks.
conditions.rerun: Independent accessibility review of those observed sessions.

conditions.affected_user_task: Customers reading the site at narrow widths, high zoom, or in browsers other than the historical Chrome capture environment.
conditions.evidence_gap: Every page has a retained desktop render and the overview has a true 390x844 capture, but narrow-width coverage does not include every page, 200% and 400% zoom were not recorded, and a current browser capture was unavailable under administrative browser policy.
conditions.consequence: Exact source and render continuity supports the observed retained layouts, not comprehensive responsive, zoom, cross-browser, or cross-operating-system behavior.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Before claiming comprehensive responsive accessibility, exercise support/trust and install/troubleshooting at narrow widths and 200%/400% zoom in representative browsers.
conditions.rerun: Visual and keyboard review of those layouts.

conditions.affected_user_task: Customers installing Nova on a current Codex or Claude-compatible host, invoking it, or following provider-controlled support and security routes.
conditions.evidence_gap: Package paths and the local Codex command surface were inspected, but no fresh-host installation, discovery, restart, real Nova invocation, or publication-time external-link check was performed.
conditions.consequence: Static documentation readiness does not prove live host behavior or continuing external-route availability.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Run a separately authorized fresh-host install and one real Nova invocation; check provider-controlled support and security routes immediately before publication.
conditions.rerun: Customer-task walkthrough using the observed live host and external routes.

separate_release_gate.note: Public redistribution remains blocked by the six rights matters recorded in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. This verdict does not authorize publication, redistribution, tag, release, directory submission, or announcement.
